info.title: Realassetnet local simulation API
info.description: Documentation of implemented V0 routes. No live financial or external agent integration. Requests are bounded JSON; browser mutations require same origin and a session-specific X-CSRF-Token. Schema does not substitute for server authorization and action-dependent policy. Response schemas are intentionally partial except the public projection; private response models evolve with the simulation.

city.description: Must be an explicit TorontoMarketPack city.

filename.description: Case-insensitive suffix; server also rejects paths and invalid/control content.

content.description: UTF-8 text numeric lines; only .txt and .csv supported. Acceptance is not antivirus clearance.

ActionRequest.description: Action-dependent validation is authoritative in app/gateway.py. Subscription requires amount, idempotency_key, acknowledge_simulation=true and exact current fee_bps; distribution requires positive amount/idempotency_key. Reviewer-only actions require separation from originator. All live/outreach/referral executors remain disabled.
